name: What is the restoration process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The restoration process typically begins with an assessment of the damage, followed by emergency services like water extraction or board-up. Then, specialized techniques such as drying, dehumidification, and cleaning are employed. Finally, reconstruction efforts restore the property to its original state. Communication with the client is maintained throughout each stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: The restoration process includes damage assessment, emergency services, specialized cleaning, and reconstruction.
